description: Angular component for configuring liquid level card widget settings in Thingsboard, including form setup, shape mapping, data fetching, and preview functions.

classes.name: LiquidLevelCardWidgetSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing the settings of a liquid level card widget, including form controls, shape mapping, data fetching, and preview functions.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for widget settings.

methods.name: onWidgetConfigSet
methods.description: Initializes component with widget configuration and loads shape mappings.

methods.name: onSettingsSet
methods.description: Populates form controls based on provided widget settings.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns list of form control names that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Updates form validators based on current form state.

methods.name: createShape
methods.description: Creates a SafeUrl shape layout from SVG string and layout type.

methods.name: _valuePreviewFn
methods.description: Generates a preview string for a value.

methods.name: _tooltipValuePreviewFn
methods.description: Generates a preview string for tooltip value.

methods.name: _totalVolumeValuePreviewFn
methods.description: Generates a preview string for total volume value.

methods.name: _datePreviewFn
methods.description: Generates a formatted date string for tooltip.

methods.name: fetchOptions
methods.description: Fetches data key options based on search text.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Retrieves data keys based on current data source.
